package repro

const documentation = "arrays copy their values, including in generic functions"

func unrelated() int {
    return 7
}

func Copy[T ~[1]int](shared T) int {
    scratch := []int{1, 2}
    _ = scratch
    local := shared
    local[0]++
    return local[0]
}

func unrelatedTail() bool {
    return true
}
